title: Report reads the results contract 1.5.0 rear-yard and constraint rows, input facts and constraint lines (page 1 and the What-constrains-the-design sheet), with a byte-identical fall-back to the 1.4.0 output; a hatched constraint overlay drawn only where established; NB-04 revision 3
objective: Make the report read the results contract 1.5.0 blocks, with an EXACT fall-back to the 1.4.0 output. (1) services/api/app/drawings/report/constraint_text.py reads rear_yard.checks and rear_yard.combined (state, way, text, conditions, zr_sections) and the permitted_envelope rows; when the document carries no 1.5.0 block it returns the current 1.4.0 output UNCHANGED, which for the rear yard is M5-T165's open-check wording (REAR_YARD_OPEN_CHECK, 23-344(b)/(c)(3) not yet checked). (2) page_site_context.py's 'What constrains the design?' (PDF page 3) rows read constraint_text.py: the hard-coded state dict at page_site_context.py:87 (:52 at plan base 2f546ec5) is removed; each row shows the row's own state/way/text; the 'see item N' span at page_site_context.py:81 becomes an <a href="#issue-<n>"> link resolving to the page_assumptions id="issue-<n>" anchors. (3) services/api/app/drawings/maps/close_frame_dimensions.py adds input_facts' other-basis lot dimensions (e.g. printed_tax_map frontage, administrative_record recorded area, gis outline area) BESIDE the map-outline dimensions, each labelled with its own basis, never averaged or merged. (4) a new services/api/app/drawings/maps/constraint_overlay.py draws geometry.constraint_lines (rear_yard_100ft_line, corner_area, street_wall_band, setback_line) on the compact site frame (shown both as the page-1 thumbnail and the page-type-2 close frame) ONLY when a line's state is 'established' (R017); lines are hatched and labelled with state and ZR section; the legend lists only what is drawn; not_established/not_known lines carry no geometry and draw nothing (R044); endpoints lie on the document's vertices within 0.01 ft. site_context_plan.py gains ONLY the thin hook that calls the overlay (near-zero SLOC; DB-250). NB-04 is revised to revision 3 to record close_frame_dimensions.py's new code identity; research_status stays 'conflicting_evidence' unchanged (G-13: only M5-T167 changes a research_status in W25). Output is byte-identical on every valid 1.4.0 fixture (S1).
business_reason: D-094 R038/R061/R079/R037: the rear yard must be read from the engine's actual 1.5.0 result (fix the data path, not the wording), shown as the open check with its own conditions and ZR links, and drawn only where geometry and legal basis are established (R017); a legal fact is not marked unknown because a feature is unfinished (R061).

acceptance_scenarios.when: the report HTML and the map SVG are built
acceptance_scenarios.then: both are byte-identical to the pre-task output (constraint_text.py falls back to the 1.4.0 text; the overlay draws nothing without constraint_lines; the #issue-<n> link affects only rows that carry a number, of which the fixtures have none)

the page-1 uncertainty and the page-3 row show the combined row's own text, labelled Conditional, with its ZR section 23-344(b) linked; no number is printed. The appendix open item's text is built in readers.py (an NB-01 code path, W25's NB-01 owner is M5-T167): it moves to M5-T167 (scope correction of 2026-10-14)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a 1.5.0 check or line in state not_known (23-344(c)(3) / corner_area in that fixture)
acceptance_scenarios.when: the row and overlay are built
acceptance_scenarios.then: the row shows no number, only its own reason/text; the not_known line carries and draws no geometry

acceptance_scenarios.given: a constraint_line whose state is not_established or not_known
acceptance_scenarios.then: it draws nothing for that line (geometry is drawn only for state=established, R017); the legend omits it

acceptance_scenarios.given: the fixture's input_facts (printed_tax_map, administrative_record, gis) and the established rear_yard_100ft_line
acceptance_scenarios.when: the close frame and overlay are built
acceptance_scenarios.then: each dimension carries its own basis label beside the map-outline dimension, nothing is averaged or merged, and the drawn line's endpoints lie on the document's vertices within 0.01 ft
every label is at least 8.5 pt with no collisions; grey/illustrative copies are distinguishable by hatching
the envelope rows render through the same reader, so M5-T170's later output needs no further report change

they use M5-T164's committed 1.5.0 examples only; no new results fixture file is added; where an #issue-<n> link needs numbered open_items the test constructs the document in memory from those examples

acceptance_scenarios.given: every internal href the report emits
acceptance_scenarios.then: each #issue-<n> resolves to a page_assumptions id="issue-<n>" anchor
revision 3 records close_frame_dimensions.py's new code identity, research_status stays 'conflicting_evidence' unchanged, exit 0
it passes; site_context_plan.py stays at or below its recorded SLOC + material-growth limit (the overlay body lives in constraint_overlay.py; site_context_plan.py gains only the thin hook)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a results document carrying geometry.constraint_lines and input_facts (built in memory from M5-T164's committed 1.5.0 examples and the benchmark's recorded map context)
acceptance_scenarios.when: the whole report is built through the live path (build_report_html and the map embed)
acceptance_scenarios.then: the page-1 frame and the close frame draw the established lines and the other-basis dimensions exactly as the unit tests of constraint_overlay.py and close_frame_dimensions.py expect; a document without them renders byte-identical (S1 still holds for every valid 1.4.0 fixture and the benchmark); nothing is drawn for a line that is not established

risks: site_context_plan.py is 597 SLOC, 3 under the 600 WARN line (DB-250): even a thin hook can cross WARN/material-growth. Keep the hook minimal; the overlay drawing lives in constraint_overlay.py. modularity_check runs in the self-check.

The 1.4.0 fall-back must reproduce BOTH the short page-3 state column strings ('Not known', 'Not worked out yet', 'Not checked', 'by portion') AND the longer open-item effect texts exactly; conflating them would redden the forbidden benchmark tests (test_constraints_page.py, test_report_pages.py, test_location_sheet.py, test_report_read_context.py).

test_constraints_page.py caps the site-and-context section at <=199 visible words (test_s10, on the benchmark); the page-3 changes must not push the benchmark section over it, and that test may not be edited (M5-T166's).
The overlay's legend/labels on the 88 mm page-1 thumbnail must stay legible and must not alter the 'summary-figure' wrapper the benchmark pins; this is a visual-quality-reviewer check.
path_notes: Runs in W25 beside M5-T167 (no shared file; M5-T167 owns NB-01, NB-03, the rule file, README and RESEARCH_REQUESTS, and the benchmark set). Builders never start a server and never touch ports 3000/3001/8000; the report-print and width-capture e2e run in CI at the task head. constraint_text.py is NOT an NB-01 code path, so this task is not an NB-01 code-path editor (G-6 stays clean for M5-T167). Orchestrator decisions on the packet check's questions (2026-10-14): a line whose state is not_established or not_known draws nothing (the contract has no 'withheld' line state); the #issue-<n> link is tested on a document built in memory from the committed 1.5.0 examples (no new results fixture); the new overlay file renders document values only and is listed in no evidence record unless the G1 reviewer decides otherwise; no review-register entry (no rule or calculation changes).
